prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for Early Rush, a cheerful commuter game. The input image is MATERIAL, COLOR and rounded-shape style reference ONLY, do not include the chair. ONE independent environment prop, actual transparent alpha background. Rounded simplified toy-like matte 2.5D raster illustration, cream ivory and muted teal with small warm yellow accents, gentle fixed upper-left light and self shading, no heavy outlines. Fixed north-up orthographic camera looking steeply down from 75 degrees above the ground. Show LARGE top surfaces and strongly foreshortened vertical sides, NOT front elevation, NOT diagonal isometric. The main front faces image bottom; horizontal edges parallel image X axis. No ground plane, no floor tiles, no cast floor shadow, no glow, no person, no lettering, numbers, brand, logo, label or watermark. Complete object with transparent safety margins. A short broad side section of a metro railway carriage, horizontally across a landscape 2:1 canvas. Cream curved roof dominates because of very high viewpoint. Lower side has one centered CLOSED double sliding door, flanked by exactly one dark teal window on each side. Thin muted teal band along carriage. No rails, platform, passengers or locomotive nose. Both side ends neatly rounded, whole carriage section visible. Door center x50%, lowest underbody contact line near y90%. Object occupies about80% canvas width and65% height. Need later open-door variant at identical framing. Prefer 2048x1024.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the exact CLOSED metro carriage sprite to edit. Change ONLY the central double sliding doors: retract left leaf to left and right leaf to right, revealing an open dark teal interior doorway with a short cream threshold. Door opening remains perfectly centered at same x coordinate and same ground level. Preserve identical image dimensions, transparency, silhouette, every carriage edge, roof, rooftop vent, two side windows, lights, horizontal color stripe, camera angle, scale, framing and fixed lighting. No people, platform, text, arrows, glow or outside floor. Do not resize, zoom or recenter the carriage. Actual alpha preserved. The result must alternate with the input without the train body jumping.
